briefing.headline: OpenAI o4-preview and DeepSeek R2 intensify AGI timeline compression

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate model releases as compute constraints tighten. US-China decoupling in chips reshapes alliances while safety concerns mount over autonomous agents.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI deploys o4-preview with advanced reasoning; Anthropic ships Claude 4 Opus; Google releases Gemini 3 Ultra; Meta open-sources Llama 4; xAI launches Grok-3; DeepSeek unveils R2. Multi-agent systems now dominate benchmarks.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent, automotive, and BCI use cases.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp hits 500k units monthly; Microsoft and Google announce $40B data center expansions in Texas and Arizona; TSMC 2nm yields improve for custom AI ASICs.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will open-source models close the gap on proprietary frontier systems by Q2 2027?
